field_definitions.raw_candidate_count: All candidate source records reviewed before validation or relevance filtering.
field_definitions.normalized_candidate_count: Valid, relevance-qualified source records in the normalized audit set after recent-source annotation; story-selection exclusions can remain for traceability.
field_definitions.relevance_qualified_source_count: Source records that passed the Gaza-nexus relevance gate before story curation.
field_definitions.excluded_source_count: Raw candidate records excluded before supporting the rendered edition.
field_definitions.selected_supporting_source_count: Distinct source records attached to rendered event clusters.
field_definitions.pre_dedupe_story_candidate_count: Story candidates created from qualified source records before same-event clustering.
field_definitions.post_dedupe_event_cluster_count: Distinct event clusters remaining after same-event deduplication.
field_definitions.rendered_development_count: Distinct public developments rendered in the edition HTML.
field_definitions.rendered_publisher_count: Distinct publishers across every supporting source attached to rendered developments.
field_definitions.raw_publisher_count: Distinct publishers represented in the raw candidate set.
field_definitions.contextual_item_count: Rendered context-only items that are not core Gaza developments.

legacy_field_semantics.final_story_count: Final distinct event clusters rendered; pre-dedupe candidates are reported separately.
legacy_field_semantics.story_count: Distinct rendered public developments in the edition manifest.
legacy_field_semantics.source_count: Normalized traceability records retained in the public sources manifest; use selected_supporting_source_count for sources supporting rendered developments.
